about: One list, two implementations: pipeline/answers.py:norm_question (tests/test_captures.py) and extension/shared/answers.js:normKey (tests/test_extension.js) must both map each question to its key. No case carries a trailing required-marker, which only the server strips. Added 24 Sep 2026, when the C#/C++ merge showed the two could only drift apart silently.
